units.translation: 629 ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧.: he holds the attention. On 631 cf. ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧; here ⟦5⟧ is combined with ⟦6⟧. ⟦7⟧ (properly 'having done business') = ⟦8⟧, as ⟦9⟧ ⟦10⟧, for which Lobeck cites from Hippocrates Π. ⟦11⟧ Δ 12 (Littré VII, 580, c. 49) ⟦12⟧ = (as it is called elsewhere) ⟦13⟧. Thus (Schütz) he had accomplished most things for the good, at least in the eyes of the right-minded (the contrast is Clytemnestra), as ⟦14⟧ ⟦15⟧, and (what Schömann compared) ⟦16⟧ ⟦17⟧. The comparatives like ⟦18⟧ (⟦19⟧ 'is good') and ⟦20⟧ are often used without an expressed comparison (Homer A 22 ⟦21⟧, where the scholiast notes: ⟦22⟧). ⟦23⟧ or ⟦24⟧ doubtful. For the thought compare what the herald says at ⟦25⟧. So after this verse one should not assume a lacuna with Hermann; but in 633 we cannot get through without a change. The scholiast read ⟦26⟧ in the dative, to ⟦27⟧ he supplies ⟦28⟧; about ⟦29⟧ he says nothing. Now it seems that ⟦30⟧ fits better with ⟦31⟧ than with a ⟦32⟧ lying in ⟦33⟧: the canopy was set up over the tub, apparently as a further honor which the wife had apparently thought of only afterwards; therefore it was also such a costly garment. And then the frame fell over, seemingly by chance, and so on. If one now writes ⟦34⟧, and takes ⟦35⟧ as the scholiast does, no difficulty remains; also ⟦36⟧ and ⟦37⟧ now form a contrast: only seemingly was he through.
but so that he may hear
have you traded as the report prevails?
the man will trade more nobly
to open the gates of the god who saved the man from the campaign
speak, pouring out good words to the well-minded
and yet I honored you among those who think well

V. 634 had an x, because of the elision of the i of ⟦1⟧ and because of the ⟦2⟧ (conjugation, i.e. -⟦3⟧ or -⟦4⟧) of the verb (Schol.); there were (as M shows) the readings ⟦5⟧- and ⟦6⟧- and further -⟦7⟧ and (lemma of the Schol.) -⟦8⟧, as indeed elsewhere ⟦9⟧ and ⟦10⟧ go side by side. ⟦11⟧ is necessary: ⟦12⟧ Pindar, ⟦13⟧ Ai. ⟦14⟧ (⟦15⟧. Turneb.).
636 As before at 629f., so now afterwards the horror of the deed is rhetorically emphasized. Cf. ⟦1⟧ to Aegisthus: ⟦2⟧;
for a man who was a general you prepared this fate
